protocol.target: EC sample in the next calendar month, mS/m; no target imputation; not continuous monthly mean
protocol.forecast_origin: 23:59:59 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh on the last day of the preceding month
protocol.horizon: One calendar month after forecast_origin's month
protocol.evaluation: Expanding-window walk-forward; refit RF at every origin
protocol.validation: Select RF configuration and overall model by common-cohort validation MAE
protocol.test: Frozen choices; earlier test observations may enter later fits only when available
protocol.historical_test_caveat: 2022-2023 results were inspected in earlier project experiments; not a blind test

limitations: Historical backtest, not an operational warning or gate-control recommendation.
No scientific validation of source EC quality; UNVERIFIED is not promoted to VALIDATED.
Availability is only a scenario unless ec_available_at has documented provenance.
A month label identifies an aggregate; it is not the original measurement timestamp.
Input has no historical revision vintages; real-time reproducibility is not certified.
